[Gazette of

F.No.2(1)/97-Pub., dated
21-10-1997.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
3. Substitution of section 31,
Ordinance XXXVII of 1961.---In the said Ordinance for section 31 the
following shall be substituted namely:--
"31. Conversion of
Corporation into a Company.--(1) With effect from the date of commencement
of the Oil and Gas Development Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997 (the
1997 Ordinance) the Corporation shall be deemed to be a company incorporated
and registered under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984), limited by
shares with an authorised capital of fifteen billion rupees and such paid up
capital as may be decided b" the Federal Government within ninety days of
such commencement.
(2) The name of the Company shall
be the Oil and Gas Development Company Limited.
(3) The Company shall be a public
company limited by shares and having its registered office in Islamabad.
(4) All the paid up shares of the
Company shall initially be issued to the Federal Government and held in the
name of the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
(5) The Federal Government may,
whenever it thinks appropriate, transfer the shares in the company to such
persons, on such terms and conditions and in such manner at it may determine.
".

4. Addition of new sections,
Ordinance XXXVII of 1961.--In the said Ordinance, after section 31,
substituted as aforesaid the following new sections shall be added, namely:--
"32. Certain
provisions of Companies Ordinance not to apply to the Company,.--(1)
The provisions of section 146 of the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984)
shall not apply to the Company and the Registrar shall, alongwith the
certificate of incorporation as herein mentioned also issue forthwith a
certificate under subsection (2) of section 146 bearing the same date as the
date of incorporation.
(2) The Company shall not be
liable to issue any prospectus or statement in lieu of prospectus for any of
the initial shares issued and the said shares shall be allotted forthwith as
herein mentioned to the Federal Government or to the persons specified in this
Ordinance.
33. Memorandum of
Association of Company, etc.--(1) The Board of Directors of the Company
shall, within ninety days of the commencement of the 1997 Ordinance prepare and
forward the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company to the
Federal Government which may approve the same with or without amendment.
(2) The approved Memorandum and
Articles of Association shall there after be filed with the Registrar who shall
forthwith register the same and issue a certificate of incorporation for the
Company under section 32 of the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984).
(3) The existing functions of the
Corporation shall be deemed to be part of the objects clause of the Memorandum
of Association of the Company and to be incorporated therein from the date of
the commencement of the 1997 Ordinance and it is hereby provided that the power
granted under the Companies Ordinance to the Company to alter its Memorandum of
Association extends to and includes the power to so alter the clauses deemed to
be incorporated in, the Memorandum of Association by virtue of this subsection.
(4) The date of incorporation
mentioned in the certificate of incorporation shall be the date of the
commencement of the 1997 Ordinance.
34. First Directors, etc.--(1)
The first Directors of the Company shall be deemed to be the Directors of the
Corporation as on the commencement of the 1997 Ordinance.
(2) The first Directors of the
Company shall be deemed to hold, as from the commencement of the 1997 Ordinance
one share each in the Company, which shares shall be held by them for and on behalf
of the Federal Government and the said shares shall be allotted accordingly.
(3) The first Chief Executive of
the Company and the first Chairman of its Board of Directors shall be deemed to
be the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Corporation as on the
commencement of the 1997 Ordinance.
(4) The first Directors and Chief
Executive of the Company shall be deemed to hold office as from the
commencement of the 1997 Ordinance and their term of office shall be deemed to
have begun from that day.
35. Certain special
provisions with respect of Company.--(1) For the removal of doubts, it
is hereby clarified that, as from the commencement of the 1997 Ordinance, the
Company shall be deemed to acquire and hold all the assets and liabilities of
whatsoever nature of the Corporation including, but not limited to, all movable
and immovable property owned by the Corporation, and all its contractual rights
and outstanding moneys shall be deemed to take over all contractual rights and
liabilities of the Corporation and to be a party in any matter pending in any
